# Table 2 and Table S2

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(glmnet)

COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES <- c("IA", "MN", "MO", "OK")
FEATURES_PER_PREDICTOR <- 21L
LAMBDAS <- 10^seq(3, -2, by = -0.1)
USE_CACHE <- FALSE
CACHE_DIR <- "results/predictor_contribution_selected"

source_list <- c(
  "Wearing Masks", "Symptoms", "Symptoms in Community", "Outpatient Visits",
  "Test Positivity", "Cases", "Deaths", "Vaccinations",
  "Policy Index", "Climate", "Hospital Admissions", "ED Visits"
)

stopifnot(
  exists("final_data"), exists("predictor_block_exclusions"), exists("selected_models"),
  exists("make_Xdata_train"), exists("make_Xdata_test"),
  exists("make_Xlist_new_labeled"), exists("make_y_labeled"), exists("get_exclusion_mask")
)

SELECTED <- selected_models %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    wlag = horizon,
    model = ifelse(has_hospitalization, "WITH", "WITHOUT"),
    k, idx = combo_index
  )

WEEK_DATES <- sort(unique(as.Date(final_data$date)))
stopifnot(length(WEEK_DATES) == 70L)

replaced_weeks <- function(wlag) {
  if (wlag <= 1L) return(integer(0))
  unlist(lapply(1:5, function(i) 10L * (i - 1L) + 20L + seq_len(wlag - 1L)))
}

build_fold_inputs <- function(wlag, dataset = final_data, n_states = 50L,
                              exclusion_rules = predictor_block_exclusions) {
  folds <- vector("list", 5L)
  for (i in 1:5) {
    if (i == 1L) {
      train_start <- 1L;                                   train_end <- n_states * 20L
      test_start  <- n_states * 15L + 1L;                  test_end  <- n_states * 30L
    } else {
      train_start <- (i - 2L) * (n_states * 10L) + (n_states * 5L + 1L)
      train_end   <- train_start + (n_states * 25L) - 1L
      test_start  <- (i - 1L) * (n_states * 10L) + (n_states * 15L + 1L)
      test_end    <- test_start + (n_states * 15L) - 1L
    }
    train_data <- dataset[train_start:train_end, , drop = FALSE]
    test_data  <- dataset[test_start:test_end, , drop = FALSE]

    X_train_result <- make_Xdata_train(dataset = train_data, lag = wlag, ylag = wlag,
                                       exclusion_rules = exclusion_rules)
    X_test_data <- make_Xdata_test(dataset = test_data, lag = wlag, ylag = wlag,
                                   bs_objects_from_train = X_train_result$bs_objects,
                                   exclusion_rules = exclusion_rules)
    X_train_labeled <- make_Xlist_new_labeled(X_train_result$data)
    X_test_labeled  <- make_Xlist_new_labeled(X_test_data)
    y_train_labeled <- make_y_labeled(train_data)
    y_test_labeled  <- make_y_labeled(test_data)

    key <- function(l) paste(as.character(l$state), as.character(as.Date(l$date)))
    if (!identical(key(X_train_labeled), key(y_train_labeled))) stop("Fold ", i, ": train X-y alignment failure.")
    if (!identical(key(X_test_labeled),  key(y_test_labeled)))  stop("Fold ", i, ": test X-y alignment failure.")

    folds[[i]] <- list(X_train = X_train_labeled, X_test = X_test_labeled,
                       y_train = y_train_labeled$obs, y_test = y_test_labeled$obs)
  }
  folds
}

fit_selected_contribution <- function(k, combo_index, wlag, fold_inputs,
                                      exclusion_rules = predictor_block_exclusions) {
  comb_indices <- combn(12, k)
  n_combos <- ncol(comb_indices)
  stopifnot(combo_index >= 1L, combo_index <= n_combos)
  selected_predictors <- as.integer(comb_indices[, combo_index])

  pred_by_fold <- contribution_by_fold <- nonzero_by_fold <- coef_by_fold <- vector("list", 5L)

  set.seed(237)
  for (fold_index in 1:5) {
    fi <- fold_inputs[[fold_index]]
    fitted <- FALSE
    for (i in seq_len(n_combos)) {
      combo_i <- as.integer(comb_indices[, i])
      mask_train_i <- get_exclusion_mask(combo_i, fi$X_train$state, fi$X_train$date, exclusion_rules)
      foldid_i <- sample(rep(seq_len(10L), length.out = sum(!mask_train_i)))
      if (i != combo_index) next

      X_train_combo <- do.call(cbind, lapply(fi$X_train$X_list[combo_i], as.matrix))
      X_test_combo  <- do.call(cbind, lapply(fi$X_test$X_list[combo_i],  as.matrix))
      storage.mode(X_train_combo) <- "double"; storage.mode(X_test_combo) <- "double"
      stopifnot(ncol(X_train_combo) == k * FEATURES_PER_PREDICTOR,
                ncol(X_test_combo)  == k * FEATURES_PER_PREDICTOR)

      mask_test_i <- get_exclusion_mask(combo_i, fi$X_test$state, fi$X_test$date, exclusion_rules)
      X_train_f <- X_train_combo[!mask_train_i, , drop = FALSE]; y_train_f <- fi$y_train[!mask_train_i]
      X_test_f  <- X_test_combo[!mask_test_i, , drop = FALSE];   y_test_f  <- fi$y_test[!mask_test_i]
      state_test_f <- as.character(fi$X_test$state[!mask_test_i])
      date_test_f  <- as.Date(fi$X_test$date[!mask_test_i])
      stopifnot(all(is.finite(X_train_f)), all(is.finite(y_train_f)),
                all(is.finite(X_test_f)), all(is.finite(y_test_f)))

      cv_fit <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(X_train_f, y_train_f, alpha = 1, family = poisson(link = "log"),
                                  lambda = LAMBDAS, standardize = TRUE, foldid = foldid_i)
      y_pred <- as.numeric(predict(cv_fit, type = "response", s = cv_fit$lambda.min, newx = X_test_f))
      coef_sparse <- coef(cv_fit, s = cv_fit$lambda.min)
      beta <- as.numeric(coef_sparse)[-1]
      stopifnot(length(beta) == k * FEATURES_PER_PREDICTOR)

      common_keep <- !state_test_f %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES
      common_counts <- table(state_test_f[common_keep])
      stopifnot(length(common_counts) == 46L, all(common_counts == 10L))

      contribution_score <- numeric(k); nonzero_count <- integer(k)
      for (b in seq_len(k)) {
        cols <- ((b - 1L) * FEATURES_PER_PREDICTOR + 1L):(b * FEATURES_PER_PREDICTOR)
        eta <- as.numeric(X_test_f[common_keep, cols, drop = FALSE] %*% beta[cols])
        contribution_score[b] <- sqrt(mean((eta - mean(eta))^2))
        nonzero_count[b] <- sum(beta[cols] != 0)
      }
      names(contribution_score) <- names(nonzero_count) <- as.character(combo_i)

      pred_by_fold[[fold_index]] <- tibble::tibble(state = state_test_f, date = date_test_f,
                                                   obs = y_test_f, pred = y_pred)
      contribution_by_fold[[fold_index]] <- contribution_score
      nonzero_by_fold[[fold_index]] <- nonzero_count
      coef_by_fold[[fold_index]] <- coef_sparse
      fitted <- TRUE
    }
    if (!fitted) stop("Target combination was not fitted.")
  }

  list(k = k, combo_index = combo_index, wlag = wlag, predictors = selected_predictors,
       y_predicted_new = dplyr::bind_rows(pred_by_fold),
       contribution_by_fold = contribution_by_fold, nonzero_by_fold = nonzero_by_fold,
       coef_by_fold = coef_by_fold,
       importance_definition = "Fold-averaged RMS of centred predictor-block contribution to the held-out log mean.")
}

verify_selected_prediction <- function(result, tolerance = 1e-6) {
  object_name <- paste0("comb", result$k, "_median_vac.lag", result$wlag)
  if (!exists(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) stop("Reference object not found: ", object_name)
  ref <- get(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)$y_predicted_new[[result$combo_index]] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state), date = as.Date(date)) %>% dplyr::arrange(state, date)
  new <- result$y_predicted_new %>%
    dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state), date = as.Date(date)) %>% dplyr::arrange(state, date)
  stopifnot(nrow(new) == nrow(ref),
            identical(paste(new$state, new$date), paste(ref$state, ref$date)),
            isTRUE(all.equal(new$obs, ref$obs, tolerance = 0)))

  keep <- !(new$date %in% WEEK_DATES[replaced_weeks(result$wlag)])
  max_diff <- max(abs(new$pred[keep] - ref$pred[keep]))
  if (max_diff >= tolerance) stop("Prediction reproduction FAILED (max difference = ", max_diff, ").")
  invisible(max_diff)
}

summarize_selected_contribution <- function(result) {
  p <- result$predictors; k <- length(p); n_folds <- length(result$contribution_by_fold)
  cm <- matrix(NA_real_, n_folds, k, dimnames = list(NULL, as.character(p)))
  nm <- matrix(NA_integer_, n_folds, k, dimnames = list(NULL, as.character(p)))
  for (f in seq_len(n_folds)) {
    cm[f, ] <- result$contribution_by_fold[[f]][as.character(p)]
    nm[f, ] <- result$nonzero_by_fold[[f]][as.character(p)]
  }
  tibble::tibble(
    predictor_number = p, predictor_name = source_list[p],
    mean_contribution_rms = colMeans(cm), median_contribution_rms = apply(cm, 2, median),
    min_contribution_rms = apply(cm, 2, min), max_contribution_rms = apply(cm, 2, max),
    folds_with_nonzero_features = colSums(nm > 0), mean_number_nonzero_features = colMeans(nm)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_contribution_rms), predictor_number) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(importance_rank = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::select(importance_rank, dplyr::everything())
}

fit_or_load_selected <- function(k, idx, wlag, fold_inputs) {
  path <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, sprintf("contribution_lag%d_k%d_idx%d.rds", wlag, k, idx))
  if (USE_CACHE && file.exists(path)) {
    result <- readRDS(path)
    verify_selected_prediction(result)
    return(result)
  }
  result <- fit_selected_contribution(k = k, combo_index = idx, wlag = wlag, fold_inputs = fold_inputs)
  verify_selected_prediction(result)
  if (USE_CACHE) {
    dir.create(CACHE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    saveRDS(result, path)
  }
  result
}

imp_display <- function(x) {
  x %>% dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(c(mean_contribution_rms, median_contribution_rms, min_contribution_rms, max_contribution_rms),
                  ~ sprintf("%.3f", .x)),
    mean_number_nonzero_features = sprintf("%.1f", mean_number_nonzero_features))
}
ordering_line <- function(df, label) {
  cat(label, ":\n  ", paste(seq_len(nrow(df)), df$predictor_name, sep = ". ", collapse = "  |  "), "\n", sep = "")
}

importance <- list()
for (h in 1:3) {
  fold_inputs <- build_fold_inputs(wlag = h)
  for (m in c("WITH", "WITHOUT")) {
    s <- SELECTED %>% dplyr::filter(wlag == h, model == m)
    stopifnot(nrow(s) == 1L)
    result <- fit_or_load_selected(k = s$k, idx = s$idx, wlag = h, fold_inputs = fold_inputs)
    imp <- summarize_selected_contribution(result)
    importance[[paste0("lag", h, "_", m)]] <- imp
    print(imp_display(imp), n = Inf, width = Inf)
  }
}

ordering_line(importance$lag3_WITH,    "3-week WITH")
ordering_line(importance$lag3_WITHOUT, "3-week WITHOUT")
ordering_line(importance$lag1_WITH,    "1-week WITH")
ordering_line(importance$lag1_WITHOUT, "1-week WITHOUT")
ordering_line(importance$lag2_WITH,    "2-week WITH")
ordering_line(importance$lag2_WITHOUT, "2-week WITHOUT")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

best_by_size <- function(all_df, has_hosp) {
  all_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_hospitalization == has_hosp) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(k) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(rmse = min(median_state_rmse_46), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(k)
}

build_table_S1 <- function(has_hosp) {
  purrr::reduce(
    list(
      best_by_size(all_lag1_46, has_hosp) %>% dplyr::rename(`1-week` = rmse),
      best_by_size(all_lag2_46, has_hosp) %>% dplyr::rename(`2-week` = rmse),
      best_by_size(all_lag3_46, has_hosp) %>% dplyr::rename(`3-week` = rmse)
    ),
    dplyr::left_join,
    by = "k"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-k, ~ sprintf("%.3f", .x)))
}

table_S1_with    <- build_table_S1(TRUE)
table_S1_without <- build_table_S1(FALSE)

print(table_S1_with, n = Inf)
print(table_S1_without, n = Inf)
```

# Table S3

```{r}
library(dplyr)

ADMISSIONS_INDEX <- 11L
lags <- c("lag1", "lag2", "lag3")

results_by_lag <- setNames(
  lapply(lags, function(lag) {
    if (lag == "lag3") all_lag3_46 else compute_all_median_46(lag)
  }),
  lags
)

pick_best <- function(lag, include_hosp) {
  results_by_lag[[lag]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_hospitalization == include_hosp) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(median_state_rmse_46, k, combo_index) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
}

pick_hosp_only <- function(lag) {
  results_by_lag[[lag]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(k == 1, predictor_numbers == as.character(ADMISSIONS_INDEX)) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
}

get_persistence_median46 <- function(lag, k, idx, h) {

  model_pred <- get(paste0("comb", k, "_median_vac.", lag))$y_predicted_new[[idx]] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state), date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES) %>%
    dplyr::select(state, date, obs)

  persistence <- final_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state), date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(state, date) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(persist_pred = dplyr::lag(Hospital.Admissions, n = h)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(state, date, persist_pred)

  model_pred %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(persistence, by = c("state", "date")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(persist_pred)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((persist_pred - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::summarise(m = median(rmse)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(m)
}

row_from <- function(picker) {
  vapply(lags, function(lag) picker(lag)$median_state_rmse_46, numeric(1))
}

row_hosp_only    <- row_from(pick_hosp_only)
row_best_with    <- row_from(function(lag) pick_best(lag, TRUE))
row_best_without <- row_from(function(lag) pick_best(lag, FALSE))

row_locf <- vapply(lags, function(lag) {
  best <- pick_best(lag, TRUE)
  get_persistence_median46(lag, best$k, best$combo_index,
                           h = as.integer(sub("lag", "", lag)))
}, numeric(1))

table_s3 <- tibble::tibble(
  Model = c(
    "Naïve (LOCF)",
    "Hospital admissions only",
    "Best model including hospital admissions",
    "Best model excluding hospital admissions"
  ),
  `1-week` = c(row_locf[["lag1"]], row_hosp_only[["lag1"]],
               row_best_with[["lag1"]], row_best_without[["lag1"]]),
  `2-week` = c(row_locf[["lag2"]], row_hosp_only[["lag2"]],
               row_best_with[["lag2"]], row_best_without[["lag2"]]),
  `3-week` = c(row_locf[["lag3"]], row_hosp_only[["lag3"]],
               row_best_with[["lag3"]], row_best_without[["lag3"]])
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .x)))

as.data.frame(table_s3)
```


# Table S5

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

source_list <- c(
  "Wearing Masks", "Symptoms", "Symptoms in Community", "Outpatient Visits",
  "Test Positivity", "Cases", "Deaths", "Vaccinations",
  "Policy Index", "Climate", "Hospital Admissions", "ED Visits"
)


PREDICTOR_ABBR <- c(
  "WM", "Sx", "SxC", "OV",
  "TP", "Ca", "De", "Va",
  "PI", "Cl", "HA", "ED"
)

SWITCH_AT <- 6L

all_metrics <- purrr::map_dfr(1:12, function(k) {

  pred_list <- get(paste0("comb", k, "_median_vac.lag3"))$y_predicted_new
  stopifnot(length(pred_list) == choose(12, k))

  purrr::imap_dfr(pred_list, function(pred_tbl, combo_index) {

    d <- pred_tbl %>%
      dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES)

    stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(d$state) == 46L)

    state_rmse <- d %>%
      dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop")

    tibble::tibble(
      k = k,
      combo_index = as.integer(combo_index),
      median_rmse = median(state_rmse$rmse),
      pooled_rmse = sqrt(mean((d$pred - d$obs)^2))
    )
  })
})

combo_label <- function(k, idx, abbr = TRUE) {

  members <- as.integer(combn(12, k, simplify = FALSE)[[idx]])
  nm <- if (abbr) PREDICTOR_ABBR else source_list

  if (k <= SWITCH_AT) {
    paste(nm[members], collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    excluded <- setdiff(1:12, members)
    if (length(excluded) == 0) {
      "all"
    } else {
      paste0("all except ", paste(nm[excluded], collapse = ", "))
    }
  }
}

best_by <- function(metric) {
  all_metrics %>%
    dplyr::group_by(k) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[metric]], combo_index, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      k,
      selected = purrr::map2_chr(k, combo_index, combo_label),
      rmse = .data[[metric]]
    )
}

rank_cor <- all_metrics %>%
  dplyr::group_by(k) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    spearman = if (dplyr::n() > 2L) {
      cor(median_rmse, pooled_rmse, method = "spearman")
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

table_s5 <- best_by("median_rmse") %>%
  dplyr::rename(sel_median = selected, rmse_median = rmse) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    best_by("pooled_rmse") %>%
      dplyr::rename(sel_pooled = selected, rmse_pooled = rmse),
    by = "k"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(rank_cor, by = "k") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    `Model size` = k,
    `Predictors selected by median RMSE` = sel_median,
    `Median RMSE` = sprintf("%.3f", rmse_median),
    `Predictors selected by pooled RMSE` = sel_pooled,
    `Pooled RMSE` = sprintf("%.3f", rmse_pooled),
    `Spearman rho` = ifelse(is.na(spearman), "-", sprintf("%.2f", spearman))
  )

for (i in seq_len(nrow(table_s5))) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "k=%-2s | median %s : %s\n       | pooled %s : %s\n       | Spearman rho = %s\n\n",
    table_s5$`Model size`[i],
    table_s5$`Median RMSE`[i],
    table_s5$`Predictors selected by median RMSE`[i],
    table_s5$`Pooled RMSE`[i],
    table_s5$`Predictors selected by pooled RMSE`[i],
    table_s5$`Spearman rho`[i]
  ))
}

cat("Abbreviations: ",
    paste(sprintf("%s = %s", PREDICTOR_ABBR, source_list), collapse = "; "),
    "\n", sep = "")

range(rank_cor$spearman, na.rm = TRUE)
```


# Table S6

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)


national_model <- selected_models %>%
  dplyr::filter(horizon == 3L, has_hospitalization)
stopifnot(nrow(national_model) == 1L)
NATIONAL_K <- national_model$k
NATIONAL_IDX <- national_model$combo_index

N_STATES_EXPECTED    <- 46L
N_FORECASTS_EXPECTED <- 50L
N_CANDIDATES         <- 4095L
HI_EXCLUDE_DATE      <- as.Date("2022-02-06")

all_state_rmse <- purrr::map_dfr(1:12, function(k) {

  pred_list <- get(paste0("comb", k, "_median_vac.lag3"))$y_predicted_new
  stopifnot(length(pred_list) == choose(12, k))

  purrr::imap_dfr(pred_list, function(pred_tbl, combo_index) {
    pred_tbl %>%
      dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state), date = as.Date(date)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!(state == "HI" & date == HI_EXCLUDE_DATE)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)),
        n_forecasts = dplyr::n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(k = k, combo_index = as.integer(combo_index))
  })
})

stopifnot(
  nrow(dplyr::distinct(all_state_rmse, k, combo_index)) == N_CANDIDATES,
  dplyr::n_distinct(all_state_rmse$state) == N_STATES_EXPECTED,
  all(dplyr::count(all_state_rmse, k, combo_index, name = "n")$n == N_STATES_EXPECTED),
  all(all_state_rmse$n_forecasts[all_state_rmse$state != "HI"] == N_FORECASTS_EXPECTED),
  all(all_state_rmse$n_forecasts[all_state_rmse$state == "HI"] == N_FORECASTS_EXPECTED - 1L),
  all(is.finite(all_state_rmse$rmse)),
  all(all_state_rmse$rmse > 0)
)

national_state_rmse <- all_state_rmse %>%
  dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rank_in_state = dplyr::min_rank(rmse)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(k == NATIONAL_K, combo_index == NATIONAL_IDX) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(state, national_rmse = rmse, national_rank = rank_in_state)

stopifnot(nrow(national_state_rmse) == N_STATES_EXPECTED)

state_best <- all_state_rmse %>%
  dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = rmse, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    state,
    best_k = k,
    best_combo_index = combo_index,
    state_best_rmse = rmse
  )

het <- national_state_rmse %>%
  dplyr::left_join(state_best, by = "state") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    relative_improvement = 100 * (national_rmse - state_best_rmse) / national_rmse,
    national_percentile = 100 * national_rank / N_CANDIDATES
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    best_predictor_indices = list(
      as.integer(combn(12, best_k, simplify = FALSE)[[best_combo_index]])
    ),
    best_predictors = paste(source_list[best_predictor_indices], collapse = ", "),
    best_has_admissions = 11L %in% best_predictor_indices
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(state)

cat(sprintf(
  "Number of states                                 : %d\n",
  nrow(het)
))

cat(sprintf(
  "Median rank of national-best model               : %d / %s (top %.1f%%)\n",
  as.integer(median(het$national_rank)),
  format(N_CANDIDATES, big.mark = ","),
  median(het$national_percentile)
))

cat(sprintf(
  "Median RMSE of the national-best model           : %.3f\n",
  median(het$national_rmse)
))

cat(sprintf(
  "Median RMSE of the state-best models             : %.3f\n",
  median(het$state_best_rmse)
))

cat(sprintf(
  "Median percent reduction (state-best vs national): %.1f%% (IQR %.1f%%-%.1f%%)\n",
  median(het$relative_improvement),
  quantile(het$relative_improvement, 0.25),
  quantile(het$relative_improvement, 0.75)
))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

parse_nums <- function(x) as.integer(strsplit(x, ",\\s*")[[1]])

univariate <- all_lag3_46 %>%
  dplyr::filter(k == 1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pred = as.integer(predictor_numbers),
    name = source_list[pred]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(pred, name, individual = median_state_rmse_46)

bivariate <- all_lag3_46 %>%
  dplyr::filter(k == 2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(nums = lapply(predictor_numbers, parse_nums)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(vapply(nums, function(v) 11L %in% v, logical(1))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pred = vapply(nums, function(v) v[v != 11L], integer(1))) %>%
  dplyr::select(pred, combined = median_state_rmse_46)

# Hospital admissions has no bivariate counterpart
table_s7 <- univariate %>%
  dplyr::left_join(bivariate, by = "pred") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(individual) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    individual = sprintf("%.3f", individual),
    combined = ifelse(is.na(combined), "\u2013", sprintf("%.3f", combined))
  )

print(table_s7, n = Inf)

reduction <- univariate %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(bivariate, by = "pred") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(reduction_pct = 100 * (individual - combined) / individual)
stopifnot(nrow(reduction) == 11L)
mean_red <- mean(reduction$reduction_pct)
se_red <- sd(reduction$reduction_pct) / sqrt(nrow(reduction))
cat(sprintf("Mean reduction: %.1f%% | 95%% CI (normal): %.1f-%.1f%% | 95%% CI (t): %.1f-%.1f%%\n",
            mean_red, mean_red - 1.96 * se_red, mean_red + 1.96 * se_red,
            mean_red - qt(0.975, nrow(reduction) - 1) * se_red,
            mean_red + qt(0.975, nrow(reduction) - 1) * se_red))
print(reduction %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(reduction_pct)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(individual, combined, reduction_pct), ~ round(.x, 3))), n = Inf)
```

# Table S9

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)


exclude_ed_states <- c("MN", "MO", "OK")
lags_to_check <- 0:3

safe_cor <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  if (sum(ok) < 3L || sd(x[ok]) == 0 || sd(y[ok]) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  cor(x[ok], y[ok], method = "pearson")
}

ed_hosp_df <- final_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!state %in% exclude_ed_states) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    state = as.character(state),
    date = as.Date(date),
    ed = as.numeric(ED.visits),
    hosp = as.numeric(Hospital.Admissions)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(state, date)

stopifnot(
  dplyr::n_distinct(ed_hosp_df$state) == 47L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(ed_hosp_df$date) == 70L
)

calc_bidirectional_cor <- function(df, lags) {

  df <- df %>% dplyr::arrange(date)

  purrr::map_dfr(lags, function(L) {
    tibble::tibble(
      lag_weeks = L,
      ed_to_hosp = safe_cor(df$ed, dplyr::lead(df$hosp, n = L)),
      hosp_to_ed = safe_cor(df$hosp, dplyr::lead(df$ed, n = L))
    )
  })
}

bidirectional_cor_by_state <- ed_hosp_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ calc_bidirectional_cor(.x, lags_to_check)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

stopifnot(nrow(bidirectional_cor_by_state) == 47L * length(lags_to_check))

table_s9 <- bidirectional_cor_by_state %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lag_weeks) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_states = sum(!is.na(ed_to_hosp) & !is.na(hosp_to_ed)),
    median_ed_to_hosp = median(ed_to_hosp, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_ed_to_hosp = quantile(ed_to_hosp, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_ed_to_hosp = quantile(ed_to_hosp, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_hosp_to_ed = median(hosp_to_ed, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_hosp_to_ed = quantile(hosp_to_ed, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_hosp_to_ed = quantile(hosp_to_ed, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_difference = median(ed_to_hosp - hosp_to_ed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    `Lag (weeks)` = lag_weeks,
    `N states` = n_states,
    `ED to Hosp median r` = sprintf("%.3f", median_ed_to_hosp),
    `ED to Hosp IQR` = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", q1_ed_to_hosp, q3_ed_to_hosp),
    `Hosp to ED median r` = sprintf("%.3f", median_hosp_to_ed),
    `Hosp to ED IQR` = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", q1_hosp_to_ed, q3_hosp_to_ed),
    `Median difference` = sprintf("%.3f", median_difference)
  )

as.data.frame(table_s9)
```
